jobs.description_text: Director, Connected Lifecycle Engineering Needham, MA The Opportunity Every connected SharkNinja product — the wireless link, the on-device display, the companion app experience — runs on firmware this leader owns. You will set the architecture that every connected program in the portfolio is built and gated against, and own the delivery of that firmware globally, whether it's written by your team or by an ODM/JDM partner. This is a dual-mandate role: architect and delivery owner. Architecture. You define the connectivity stack standards, pairing and provisioning protocols, display and embedded UI frameworks, and the app- and cloud-integration interfaces that gate every connected firmware program. Delivery. You own global connected-device firmware — wireless connectivity, connected-device security, over-the-air updating, on-device displays, and the differentiated connected experiences that set our products apart. You'll operate as a peer to the Embedded Firmware director (who owns non-connected embedded architecture and delivery), and partner with the Embedded Firmware director in Asia on connected features executed from that region. What You'll Own Architecture & Technical Direction Architecture, interface definitions, and integration standards for wireless connectivity, display/UI, and companion app and cloud integration — all product categories, globally. jobs.description_text: About the Role The Director, Global Strategic Programs is a commercial leader responsible for converting SharkNinja's commercial ambition into measurable, repeatable outcomes — POS and revenue growth, margin, share, and the efficient investment of our global commercial spend. Operating as a trusted advisor to the Chief Commercial Officer and a key orchestrator of the commercial agenda, this leader aligns strategy, operating model, processes, and AI-enabled capabilities to accelerate value creation across the global commercial engine. The Director, Global Strategic Programs leads the execution of ACE (the Agentic Commercial Engine) and the broader portfolio of commercial initiatives — commercial intelligence, revenue growth management, category planning, media and social analytics, and international expansion. It requires exceptional commercial acumen, executive influence, and the ability to mobilize Sales, Marketing, Social, Finance, SS&A, and IT to deliver improvements in growth, margin, speed, and decision quality. The Director, Global Strategic Programs drives outcomes not only by solving problems, but by building the durable mechanisms, operating rhythms, and adoption that raise commercial performance across every category, market, and channel. jobs.title: Program Manager - Quality Excellence
jobs.description_text: Position Overview: SharkNinja is building a new Product Excellence Program Management (PEPM) team — three roles, each owning a distinct phase of the product development lifecycle, working together to run one PE operating standard across the full lifecycle from inception to end-of-life. The vision is simple: four pods, one PE playbook — run faster. Consistent gates, escalation, and star reporting from Inception to EOL. Predicting star ratings before P0. Cutting in-market signal-to-fix to 10 days. Today, the handoffs across Product Excellence are not seamless enough. Quality insights generated upstream do not always reach the right downstream teams in time. In-market signals do not always make it back into NPD fast enough to influence the next generation. These three roles exist to close that loop — with speed. The ask for every PEPM is the same: Communicate. Act fast. Ensure the PE point of view is front and center. Each role is embedded at a specific phase of the development cycle, but all three operate as one team — sharing a common operating rhythm, a common PE playbook, and a shared accountability for ensuring nothing falls through the cracks between phases. All three roles report into VP, Product Excellence and Chief of Staff, and work in close partnership with each other, with the Product Excellence Functional leaders. jobs.title: Senior Product Integrity Engineer
jobs.description_text: This is a hands-on product quality engineering role supporting new product development (NPD). You will support the 5-star standard by executing quality reviews, testing coordination, and DFMEA analysis across assigned NPD programs, working under the direction of the Product Excellence team to help ensure products are safe, certified, and consumer-validated ahead of launch. Product Excellence's mandate is simple: every product SharkNinja ships should earn and sustain 5 stars. This role supports that mandate by executing the day-to-day quality engineering work — testing coordination, DFMEA tracking, and build-review support — that underpins each launch. This role requires strong technical execution and clear communication. You will represent the consumer voice in assigned program reviews, flag risks to your manager and cross-functional counterparts, and help drive follow-through on identified issues. You will work within Engineering, Product Development, and the broader Product Excellence organization — supporting risk identification, contributing to predictive modeling using consumer validation data, and helping execute the structured testing, regulatory, and DFMEA processes that underpin each launch. Your job is to help find issues before the consumer does. You report to leader within Product Excellence and work closely with assigned Engineering and Product Development team members on your categories. jobs.title: Unit 26 - Software & System Architect Opportunities
jobs.description_text: Build the 26th We promise the world 25 new products a year. Unit 26 builds the 26th: SharkNinja itself. Inside a company moving as fast as ours, the highest-impact work doesn’t always fit neatly into anyone’s job description. It sits between functions and stays unsolved until someone owns it completely, builds the solution, proves its value, and ships it. That’s where Unit 26 comes in. Unit 26 is a small team of builders reporting to the Chief of Staff to the CEO, with executive sponsorship and access to the C-suite from day one. Our job is to solve problems that don’t have an obvious owner or an existing solution. When your build ships, you hand it to the business unit waiting on the other side and move to the next one. Zero to one, again and again. We’re starting with just eight builders, from inside SharkNinja and out. The Role You’ll work directly with teams across SharkNinja to understand what needs to change and what a successful solution must deliver. Then you own the build. What you make will flex with the problem: an app, an algorithm, an AI agent that eliminates thousands of hours of manual work, or a system that doesn’t yet exist at SharkNinja, or anywhere else. Some of your work will change how we run the company. Some will end up inside our products. Some will be things we haven’t imagined yet. Here, the building comes first. You’ll build on top of a global innovation engine that reaches tens of millions of homes, and you’ll have a stake in the value you create.

Seasonal Sales Associates are responsible for outstanding customer service and demonstrating superior knowledge to customers during periods of high volume. In order to provide our customers with the best holiday shopping experience, you will be required to be flexible with scheduling and available to work during the following: Extended holiday hours that may include early morning shifts, weekends, and evenings. Key holiday events; including the week of Thanksgiving (including the Friday after Thanksgiving), the week of Christmas (including the day after Christmas), and the week between Christmas and New Years (including New Years Day). This is a temporary role with an expected start date in late-September 2026 and can last through early-January 2027. Opportunities to become a permanent Sales Associate may become available after the season, pending individual performance and business needs. Responsibilities will include : Supports a sales-driven environment of genuine customer experience and demonstrate extraordinary service standards Supports store team with receiving shipment and preparing product for floor placement Plans for, tracks and communicates all in transit shipment information to the leadership team Performs customizations for customers with hands-on training Maintains an efficient and well-or

jobs.title: Senior Combustion Devices Engineer II / Principal Combustion Devices Engineer
jobs.description_text: NEUTRON Neutron is a medium-lift launch vehicle being developed by Rocket Lab, a publicly traded end-to-end space company. The rocket can deliver the mega constellations of tomorrow, enable interplanetary payloads, and support human spaceflight. As a reusable platform, Neutron will deliver a very cost-effective and reliable launch solution leveraging Rocket Lab’s proven history with Electron – the third most launched rocket, worldwide, in 2024. If you’re interested in joining an incredible team in a fast-paced and rewarding environment, this is your opportunity. SENIOR COMBUSTION DEVICES ENGINEER II / PRINCIPAL COMBUSTION DEVICES ENGINEER Based out of Rocket Lab's headquarters in Long Beach, CA, the Principal/Senior Combustion Devices Engineer will be responsible for the development of one or more combustion devices (preburners, main injectors, thrust chambers assemblies and vacuum nozzles). These devices are an integral portion of the 200,000 lbf Archimedes engine, which operates in a demanding but efficient ox-rich, staged combustion architecture. In this role, you’ll take ownership of all aspects of a component: design and analysis, manufacturing and test support, and successful flights and subsequent, high-cadence, re-flights. By doing so, you will help propel the Neutron rocket, expanding human capabilities in space and providing value to the company and its shareholders. WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO: Design, analyze, and perform trades studies to achieve programmatic targets.

jobs.title: Senior Compensation Partner - Corporate Functions & M&A
jobs.description_text: PEOPLE & CULTURE Rocket Lab’s People & Culture team is responsible for looking after our most valuable asset: our people. Across our global teams, the People & Culture team supports our people and departments across recruitment, new staff orientation, compensation, learning and development. They make sure our growing and diverse global team is supported and capable of delivering our projects and customer’s missions, and they’re responsible for supporting their development, nurturing their skills and talent, and retaining the world-class people already on our team. SENIOR COMPENSATION PARTNER - CORPORATE FUNCTIONS & M&A Based out of Rocket Lab's global headquarters in Long Beach, CA, the Senior Compensation Partner is responsible for providing strategic analysis and assisting with the design, implementation, and administration of executive and broad-based compensation decisions for new hires and internal employees. You will report directly to the Director, Total Rewards and support the global People & Culture organization with deliverables required for internal leadership, board of directors, and investors. This role will support creating and driving the strategy, policy, and programs spanning all areas of compensation, benefits, and equity to ensure pay practices are designed to drive high performance and attract and retain top talent. The candidate will have the opportunity to work directly with business leaders to deliver on Rocket Lab’s compensation practices and programs.

Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions. jobs.title: Senior Supplier Development Engineer I/II – Electrical
jobs.description_text: SUPPLY CHAIN Rocket Lab’s Supply Chain team is responsible for the flow of all materials, products, and components through the business. With many of our own products functioning as critical components to our own and our customers’ missions, the Supply Chain team has a direct impact on the success of our rocket and satellite programs. They set up the assembly kits that enables our technicians to put together our Electron rockets, manage inventory, look after shipping and receiving, manage direct and indirect procurement, and inspect and ensure that all of our materials and products are compliant and up to standard. They are the chain that links our teams together, and are critical to our success. SENIOR SUPPLIER DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER I /II - ELECTRICAL Based out of Rocket Lab's headquarters in Long Beach, CA, the Senior Supplier Development Engineer I/II – Electrical is the primary technical owner of the supply base for a broad portfolio of electrical hardware. This role is responsible for leading the end-to-end industrialization of suppliers from source selection and process qualification through NPI, PPAP, and production ramp, thereby ensuring that every supplier can deliver conforming hardware at rate, on cost, and on schedule.
